description: Find licensed music tracks and sound effects in the Epidemic Sound catalogue, open to every account at no token cost. Search first with plain words for the moment; leave kind out to get both sound effects and music (each best match first), or name kind "sound_effect" or "music". It returns sound_id, title, seconds and, for music, artists, bpm, moods and genres. To use one, call again with save_id (that sound_id) and its kind: the high quality file is saved to your audio library and comes back with a generation_id (for add_sound_to_video or as a reference sound) and an audio_url. Use it for real music and real recorded effects; find_library_sound stays first for the small Switch Motion effects on the owner's account.

kind.description: sound_effect or music. Leave it out to search both. With save_id, the kind of that sound (music when left out).

limit.description: How many results, best match first. Default 6.

save_id.description: A sound_id from a search. Saves that file to your audio library instead of searching.

search.description: What the moment needs, in plain words, e.g. "upbeat summer pop", "calm piano bed", "car door slam".

seconds.description: With save_id: the seconds the search gave.

title.description: With save_id: the title the search gave, so the saved sound keeps its name.

name: find_epidemic_sound
title: Find Epidemic Sound
